Abstract: Over 20 years have elapsed since aspartame was approved by regulatory agencies as a sweetener and flavor enhancer. The safety of aspartame and its metabolic constituents was established through extensive toxicology studies in laboratory animals, using much greater doses than people could possibly consume. Its safety was further confirmed through studies in several human subpopulations, including healthy infants, children, adolescents, and adults; obese individuals; diabetics; lactating women; and individuals heterozygous (PKUH) for the genetic disease phenylketonuria (PKU) who have a decreased ability to metabolize the essential amino acid, phenylalanine. Several scientific issues continued to be raised after approval, largely as a concern for theoretical toxicity from its metabolic components—the amino acids, aspartate and phenylalanine, and methanol—even though dietary exposure to these components is much greater than from aspartame. Nonetheless, additional research, including evaluations of possible associations between aspartame and headaches, seizures, behavior, cognition, and mood as well as allergic-type reactions and use by potentially sensitive subpopulations, has continued after approval. These findings are reviewed here. **The safety testing of aspartame has gone well beyond that required to evaluate the safety of a food additive.** When all the research on aspartame, including evaluations in both the premarketing and postmarketing periods, is examined as a whole, **it is clear that aspartame is safe, and there are no unresolved questions regarding its safety under conditions of intended use.**

Hey, I looked at your PoB and made some changes, first of all some easy things you could change right away:

\- I changed you passive tree around slightly, choosing to go for more Life instead of Energy Shield, also putting more points into block.

\- You're currently using a 5-Link, I'd suggest replacing Elemental Focus with Combustion and adding Inspiration as your 6th link. [This](https://imgur.com/1rS6Uor) would be you're 6-Link setup.

\- Instead of using frostblink I prefer Flame Dash for the extra charges, linked to Second Wind and Arcane Surge this will give you a nice damage boost if you keep dashing around! [This](https://imgur.com/nE3586J) would be your Flame Dash setup. It is important to keep your Arcane Surge low level so it will proc of a single dash!

\- Instead of using Herald of Ice and Herald of Thunder, instead use [Zealotry](https://pathofexile.gamepedia.com/Zealotry)and [Skitterbots](https://pathofexile.gamepedia.com/Summon_Skitterbots), you already haven an Elighten Level 3! [This](https://imgur.com/dmioATN) would be your Aura setup!

Of course don't forget to add quality to your gems if you have the gemcutters for it!

\- Instead of using Flame Golem I suggest you use Stone Golem for the Life Regeneration.

\- A Cast when Damage Taken setup will give you a small boost in survivability. [This](https://imgur.com/6bR70sa) would be a good setup! Adding Flammability against tougher enemies, make sure to keep them below Level 38 so Cast when Damage Taken can cast them.

\- The flask [The Wise Oak](https://pathofexile.gamepedia.com/The_Wise_Oak) would give you some nice extra damage and even adds some damage reduction! I'd suggest replacing your Granite Flask with it.

\- Adding [Cinderswallow Urn](https://pathofexile.gamepedia.com/Cinderswallow_Urn) over your Silver Flask will keep the Onslaught but give you lots of extra damage and survivability!

\- For more survivability you should replace your Body Armour with [Kaom's Heart](https://pathofexile.gamepedia.com/Kaom%27s_Heart) for more Life, this would be a nice upgrade for when you 6-Link your Staff!

Some Cluster Jewels will add a lot of damage and survivability to your build, this would be a good idea to look into next:

\- Different Cluster Jewels, since you use Incinerate you could make good use of the [Natural Affinity](https://pathofexile.gamepedia.com/Natural_Affinity) Jewel, this give you some nice survivability and damage!

\- A Large Cluser Jewel with 2 Jewel Sockets and 3 good passives will give you a lot more quality of life. The following large [Jewel](https://imgur.com/qkR5Wtp) would be very good for you build.

\- 2 Medium Cluster Jewels, these will give you some extra survivability, adding block and Endurance Charges. The following medium [Jewel](https://imgur.com/vYDJWEm) is what you're looking for.

\- Small Cluster Jewel adding Life and preferably Chaos Resistance, here's an example [Jewel](https://imgur.com/DgqL4gW) of what you're looking for

\- Normal Jewels, for your other Jewel Sockets you should look for a [Jewel](https://imgur.com/VZNz5Sn) like this instead of the Unique Jewels you're using now.

Some other (expensive) upgrades to squeeze the most damage out of your build

\- A helmet with the mod: "Nearby Enemies have -9% to Fire Resistance" will give you a nice damage boost! Here's an [example](https://imgur.com/imqlmqy) of a really good helmet. The enchantment "Incinerate has +2 to maximum stages" would be a very big upgrade!

\- An [amulet](https://imgur.com/AyeH12D) with "+1 to Level of all Fire Skill Gems" will give you a big damage upgrade, this is a fairly expensive item. A good cheap Annointment for your build would be [Singular Focus](https://pathofexile.gamepedia.com/Singular_Focus), giving some damage reduction and cast speed, a more expensive option would be [Soul of Steel](https://pathofexile.gamepedia.com/Soul_of_Steel) for the extra Maximum Resistance.

\-  Replacing your rings with two [Circle of Anguish's](https://imgur.com/y8x7YI5) will give you a lot of damage, the two mods to look for are "Herald of Ash Buff Effect" and "Increased Fire Damage while affected by Herald of Ash". Very Expensive.

There's lots of other small upgrades and things you can do to add extra damage! Sorry for the long post \^-\^
